Title: Roam Boost
Body (HTML):
Clip-on power assist for manual wheelchairs. Push less, go further.

  • Fits most rigid and folding frames with 22 to 26 inch wheels
  • Range: up to 20 km per charge
  • Top assisted speed: 6 km/h
  • Weight: 5.8 kg
  • Clips on and off without tools

Title: Roam Court Wheels
Body (HTML):
Sports wheels for court and track. Sold as a pair.

  • Size: 24 inch
  • Quick-release axles, 12.7 mm (check your chair before ordering)
  • Works with cambered sports frames
  • Weight: 1.9 kg per wheel
  • Aluminium push rims included

Title: Roam All-Terrain Rollator
Body (HTML):
A rollator for pavements, grass and gravel. Sit when you want to.

  • Front wheels: 25 cm, air-free tyres
  • Seat height: 55 cm
  • Supports up to 136 kg
  • Weight: 8.7 kg
  • Hand brakes with parking lock
  • Folds flat for the car

Title: Roam Trail Cane
Body (HTML):
A carbon-fibre cane that folds into your bag.

  • Height: adjusts from 84 to 94 cm
  • Folds to 30 cm
  • Supports up to 100 kg
  • Weight: 290 g
  • Ergonomic handle, non-slip rubber tip

Title: Roam Grip Aid
Body (HTML):
Holds your hand to the handle so you can train with a limited grip.

  • Works with weights, rackets, paddles and handlebars
  • One size, fits left or right hand
  • Wide hook-and-loop wrist strap with pull tab
  • Weight: 120 g
  • Machine washable

Title: Roam Clamp Phone Mount
Body (HTML):
Keeps your phone in reach on a wheelchair or rollator.

  • Clamps to tubing from 19 to 38 mm
  • Holds phones from 4.7 to 6.9 inches
  • Rotates 360 degrees
  • Weight: 210 g
  • Large knob, no tools needed

Title: Roam Light Touch Keyboard
Body (HTML):
Big keys that need only a light press. Built for limited finger movement.

  • Key size: 25 mm, widely spaced
  • Removable keyguard stops accidental presses
  • Connects by USB-C or Bluetooth
  • Works with Windows, macOS, Android and iPadOS
  • Weight: 780 g

Title: Roam Recover
Body (HTML):
A massage gun you can hold with a limited grip. For warm-up and after training.

  • Closed loop handle: slide your hand through, no squeezing
  • One large button, 4 speeds
  • Battery: up to 3 hours
  • Weight: 650 g
  • Not a medical device

Title: Roam Flash Doorbell
Body (HTML):
A doorbell you see. The receiver flashes when someone presses the button.

  • Wireless range: up to 150 m
  • Bright strobe light, optional chime
  • Plug-in receiver, 220 V
  • Weatherproof door button, battery included
  • Weight: 260 g

Title: Roam Shake Alarm Clock
Body (HTML):
Wakes you by shaking the bed and flashing a light.

  • Bed-shaker disc goes under your pillow or mattress
  • 3 alert modes: shake, flash, or both
  • Large dimmable display
  • Battery backup for power cuts
  • Weight: 480 g

Title: Roam Voice 8
Body (HTML):
Press a button, it speaks your message. Record in any language.

  • 8 large buttons, 10 seconds of recording each
  • 3 levels, 24 messages in total
  • Swappable picture cards
  • Built-in speaker with volume dial
  • USB-C rechargeable
  • Weight: 620 g

Title: Roam Talk Board
Body (HTML):
Point to say it. A communication board that goes anywhere, including the pool.

  • Size: A4
  • 48 picture symbols
  • English on one side, Filipino on the other
  • Waterproof, wipes clean
  • Weight: 140 g
  • Lanyard loop

Title: Roam Braille Keys
Body (HTML):
Type braille on your phone or laptop.

  • 8-key braille layout plus space bar
  • Bluetooth: iOS, Android, Windows and macOS
  • Works with VoiceOver and TalkBack
  • Battery: up to 40 hours
  • Weight: 330 g

Title: Roam Talking Induction Cooker
Body (HTML):
An induction cooker that tells you what it is doing.

  • Speaks power level, timer and pan detection
  • Tactile dial with a click for each step
  • Raised ring marks the cooking zone
  • 2000 W, 220 V
  • Auto shut-off
  • Weight: 2.6 kg

Title: Roam Folding White Cane
Body (HTML):
A light graphite white cane that folds into five sections.

  • Length: 125 cm
  • Rolling ball tip
  • Non-slip grip with wrist loop
